query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS biosynthetic_pathways (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  abbreviation VARCHAR(50),
  location ENUM('plastid', 'cytosol', 'mitochondria', 'both') NOT NULL,
  main_products TEXT,
  key_enzymes TEXT,
  precursors TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  source_reference VARCHAR(500),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
